materials.title: In a Glass Workshop
materials.text:
1. First sentence: We arranged for a specialist to repair the furnace controller last week.
Second sentence: We ____ by a specialist last week.
Key word: GOT

2. First sentence: The beginner was not accustomed to working near such heat.
Second sentence: The beginner was ____ near such heat.
Key word: USED

3. First sentence: The designer gave us permission to photograph the glassmaking process.
Second sentence: The designer ____ the glassmaking process.
Key word: ALLOWED

4. First sentence: They polished the panel for an hour before the crack became visible.
Second sentence: They ____ the panel before the crack became visible.
Key word: SPENT

5. First sentence: Visitors are forbidden to enter the cooling area.
Second sentence: On ____ the cooling area.
Key word: ACCOUNT

6. First sentence: I forgot to wear gloves, and I regret it now.
Second sentence: I ____ gloves.
Key word: WISH

questions.prompt:
We arranged for a specialist to repair the furnace controller last week.
Use GOT: We ____ by a specialist last week.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: get something done表示安排他人完成，got保留上周过去事件，by a specialist仍明确专家施事；repair应为被动分词repaired。

questions.prompt:
The beginner was not accustomed to working near such heat.
Use USED: The beginner was ____ near such heat.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: be used to doing表示习惯于某种环境中的工作，not保留尚不习惯；to在此为介词，后接working而非work。

questions.prompt:
The designer gave us permission to photograph the glassmaking process.
Use ALLOWED: The designer ____ the glassmaking process.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: allow somebody to do对应给予拍摄许可，保留设计师、我们和过去许可事件；不定式to不能在这个补语结构中省略。

questions.prompt:
They polished the panel for an hour before the crack became visible.
Use SPENT: They ____ the panel before the crack became visible.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: spend time doing表达花一小时抛光，before保留裂纹出现前的时间顺序；简单过去或过去完成均可，to polish不能替换动名词补语。

questions.prompt:
Visitors are forbidden to enter the cooling area.
Use ACCOUNT: On ____ the cooling area.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: no account are visitors to enter
questions.explanation: on no account前置表示绝对禁止并要求助动词与主语部分倒装；保留游客不得进入，不能写成未倒装的visitors may。

questions.prompt:
I forgot to wear gloves, and I regret it now.
Use WISH: I ____ gloves.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: wish加过去完成时表示对先前没有戴手套的遗憾，保留现在后悔与过去未做的关系；have worn不能在此表达过去反事实。

materials.title: At the Cable-Car Station
materials.text:
1. First sentence: The cable-car service stopped because of ice.
Second sentence: The stoppage of the cable-car service ____ ice.
Key word: DUE

2. First sentence: The guide advised us not to lean out of the car.
Second sentence: The guide ____ of the car.
Key word: AGAINST

3. First sentence: We could not see the valley because of the thick cloud.
Second sentence: The thick cloud ____ the valley.
Key word: PREVENTED

4. First sentence: The last car left before the storm arrived.
Second sentence: When the storm arrived, the last car ____.
Key word: ALREADY

5. First sentence: Operators will refund your ticket if the service remains closed.
Second sentence: Operators will refund your ticket ____.
Key word: PROVIDED

6. First sentence: The engineer checked the cable every day while she worked there.
Second sentence: The engineer ____ every day while she worked there.
Key word: USED

questions.prompt:
The cable-car service stopped because of ice.
Use DUE: The stoppage of the cable-car service ____ ice.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: be due to在此说明停运由冰造成，名词化仍保留相同过去事件与原因；due of不构成这种原因搭配。

questions.prompt:
The guide advised us not to lean out of the car.
Use AGAINST: The guide ____ of the car.
Write only the missing words.

rejectedAnswers: advised us against to lean out

questions.explanation: advise somebody against doing表示劝我们不要探身，保留导游给建议而非禁止的言语行为；against后不能接to lean。

questions.prompt:
We could not see the valley because of the thick cloud.
Use PREVENTED: The thick cloud ____ the valley.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: prevent somebody from doing或英式省略from均能表达浓云阻碍我们看谷地；to seeing不是该动词合格的补语形式。

questions.prompt:
The last car left before the storm arrived.
Use ALREADY: When the storm arrived, the last car ____.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: 过去完成时had already left保留最后一车先离开、暴风后到的顺序；has already leave既错置现在时又缺过去分词。

questions.prompt:
Operators will refund your ticket if the service remains closed.
Use PROVIDED: Operators will refund your ticket ____.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: provided that the service remains closed

rejectedAnswers: provided that the service remain closed

questions.explanation: provided或provided that在此引出持续关闭这一退款条件，保留will主句；一般现在时单数service要求remains，不能省略词尾。

questions.prompt:
The engineer checked the cable every day while she worked there.
Use USED: The engineer ____ every day while she worked there.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: used to加动词原形表达她在当地任职时的过去习惯，保留每日检查；它不同于be used to doing，不能写checking。

materials.title: After an Online Chess Game
materials.text:
1. First sentence: The rules do not allow you to take this move back.
Second sentence: Under the rules, you ____ this move back.
Key word: ALLOWED

2. First sentence: I only realised my king was in trouble after the clock had stopped.
Second sentence: I did not realise my king was in trouble ____.
Key word: UNTIL

3. First sentence: I am sure you moved the knight before starting the clock.
Second sentence: You ____ before starting the clock.
Key word: MUST

4. First sentence: The arbiter cancelled the game because of a connection failure.
Second sentence: The game ____ because of a connection failure.
Key word: CANCELLED

5. First sentence: It is not worth arguing about that position.
Second sentence: There ____ about that position.
Key word: POINT

6. First sentence: The only thing I want to do now is review the endgame.
Second sentence: ____ now is review the endgame.
Key word: ALL

questions.prompt:
The rules do not allow you to take this move back.
Use ALLOWED: Under the rules, you ____ this move back.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: be not allowed to do转换为受规则约束的被动许可，保持不能悔棋；allowed后需要to take而不是taking。

questions.prompt:
I only realised my king was in trouble after the clock had stopped.
Use UNTIL: I did not realise my king was in trouble ____.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: not realise until对应计时停止后才意识到，保留过去完成的先后；has stop混用现在助动词和非分词，不能构成该过去关系。

questions.prompt:
I am sure you moved the knight before starting the clock.
Use MUST: You ____ before starting the clock.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: must have done表达现在对过去走马行为的确定推断，保留you施事及启钟前；情态动词后用have而不是had。

questions.prompt:
The arbiter cancelled the game because of a connection failure.
Use CANCELLED: The game ____ because of a connection failure.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: 被动was cancelled把棋局作主语，by仍保留裁判施事，连接故障原因不变；from不能在此替代被动施事介词。

questions.prompt:
It is not worth arguing about that position.
Use POINT: There ____ about that position.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: there is no point in doing表示争论该局面没有意义，对应not worth；in后用动名词，to arguing不符合此固定结构。

questions.prompt:
The only thing I want to do now is review the endgame.
Use ALL: ____ now is review the endgame.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: all I want to do构成主语，保留现在只想复盘残局而非另一行动；want后的to接原形do，不能写doing。

materials.title: Waiting for the Harbour Pilot
materials.text:
1. First sentence: The pilot transfer was cancelled because of heavy fog.
Second sentence: The pilot transfer was cancelled ____ heavy fog.
Key word: RESULT

2. First sentence: The captain does not intend to sail without a pilot.
Second sentence: The captain ____ without a pilot.
Key word: INTENTION

3. First sentence: No unauthorised person is allowed to board the launch.
Second sentence: Unauthorised people ____ the launch.
Key word: PERMISSION

4. First sentence: It was necessary for the crew to secure the rope before departing.
Second sentence: The crew ____ before departing.
Key word: HAD

5. First sentence: The pilot agreed to board only after he saw the ladder's inspection record.
Second sentence: ____ the ladder's inspection record did the pilot agree to board.
Key word: ONLY

6. First sentence: The duty officer made certain that all names were recorded.
Second sentence: The duty officer ____ recorded.
Key word: SURE

questions.prompt:
The pilot transfer was cancelled because of heavy fog.
Use RESULT: The pilot transfer was cancelled ____ heavy fog.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: as a result of引出浓雾这一取消原因，事件和过去被动都保持不变；固定搭配结尾为of而非to。

questions.prompt:
The captain does not intend to sail without a pilot.
Use INTENTION: The captain ____ without a pilot.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: have no intention of doing表示船长没有无引航员出航的打算，保留否定意向；to sailing不能替代of加动名词。

questions.prompt:
No unauthorised person is allowed to board the launch.
Use PERMISSION: Unauthorised people ____ the launch.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: do not have permission to board
questions.explanation: have no permission to board表达未经授权者没有登艇许可，保留规则性否定；permission后的动作需to board而非boarding。

questions.prompt:
It was necessary for the crew to secure the rope before departing.
Use HAD: The crew ____ before departing.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: had to do表达过去必须固定绳索，before departing仍保留离开之前的要求；to后应为secure而非securing。

questions.prompt:
The pilot agreed to board only after he saw the ladder's inspection record.
Use ONLY: ____ the ladder's inspection record did the pilot agree to board.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: only after前置接时间从句，主句已有did倒装，saw或had seen均保留查看记录后才同意登船；过去事件不能用he see。

questions.prompt:
The duty officer made certain that all names were recorded.
Use SURE: The duty officer ____ recorded.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: made sure that all names were

rejectedAnswers: made sure that all names was

questions.explanation: make sure与make certain对应，保留值班员确保所有名字被记下；复数all names的过去被动助动词为were，不是was。

materials.title: Editing a Marine Documentary
materials.text:
1. First sentence: Their footage was so blurred that we could not identify the fish.
Second sentence: Their footage ____ identify the fish.
Key word: TOO

2. First sentence: She finds it difficult to edit audio and video at the same time.
Second sentence: She ____ audio and video at the same time.
Key word: DIFFICULTY

3. First sentence: The narrator must pronounce every place name correctly.
Second sentence: It ____ pronounce every place name correctly.
Key word: ESSENTIAL

4. First sentence: We will release the film if all permissions arrive.
Second sentence: We will release the film ____.
Key word: PROVIDED

5. First sentence: I regret including that unverified caption.
Second sentence: I ____ that unverified caption.
Key word: WISH

6. First sentence: The editor made us remove the title card.
Second sentence: We ____ the title card by the editor.
Key word: WERE

questions.prompt:
Their footage was so blurred that we could not identify the fish.
Use TOO: Their footage ____ identify the fish.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: was too blurred for us to
questions.explanation: too blurred for us to do保留影像模糊到我们无法辨鱼的结果；for us后需to连接identify，不能直接接动词。

questions.prompt:
She finds it difficult to edit audio and video at the same time.
Use DIFFICULTY: She ____ audio and video at the same time.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: have difficulty doing或in doing表示同时剪音画有困难，保持她的当下情况；to editing不属于此补语结构。

questions.prompt:
The narrator must pronounce every place name correctly.
Use ESSENTIAL: It ____ pronounce every place name correctly.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: is essential for the narrator to
questions.explanation: It is essential for somebody to do或that加原形虚拟语气均保留叙述者必须正确读地名；for结构缺to时不能直接接pronounce。

questions.prompt:
We will release the film if all permissions arrive.
Use PROVIDED: We will release the film ____.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: provided引出所有许可到齐这一发布条件，不改变主句will或肯定条件关系；复数permissions后的动词应为arrive。

questions.prompt:
I regret including that unverified caption.
Use WISH: I ____ that unverified caption.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: wish加过去完成否定表示后悔已经加了未核实字幕，保留过去行为与现在遗憾；would not included既缺正确动词结构也不表达该反事实。

questions.prompt:
The editor made us remove the title card.
Use WERE: We ____ the title card by the editor.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: make somebody do转被动为somebody were made to do，必须恢复to；by the editor保留编辑施事，事件仍为过去强制删除片头卡。

materials.title: Restoring a Public Fountain
materials.text:
1. First sentence: The contractor completed the repair even though the pump failed.
Second sentence: The contractor completed the repair ____.
Key word: DESPITE

2. First sentence: The council rejected our proposal for a more powerful pump.
Second sentence: The council ____ for a more powerful pump.
Key word: DOWN

3. First sentence: The fountain's most recent use was twenty years before the restoration began.
Second sentence: The restoration began twenty years ____.
Key word: LAST

4. First sentence: The council considers durability more important than colour.
Second sentence: The council ____ colour.
Key word: PRIORITY

5. First sentence: Without local donations, the work would have stopped.
Second sentence: The work would have stopped ____.
Key word: BUT

6. First sentence: The engineer warned us not to switch on the pump.
Second sentence: The engineer ____ on the pump.
Key word: AGAINST

questions.prompt:
The contractor completed the repair even though the pump failed.
Use DESPITE: The contractor completed the repair ____.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: despite后接名词或动名词结构，均保留泵故障但修复仍完成的让步；不能直接跟the pump had failed有限从句。

questions.prompt:
The council rejected our proposal for a more powerful pump.
Use DOWN: The council ____ for a more powerful pump.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: turn down表示拒绝方案，保留委员会施事、我们的提案及过去时间；该短语直接接宾语，不在our proposal前加to。

questions.prompt:
The fountain's most recent use was twenty years before the restoration began.
Use LAST: The restoration began twenty years ____.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: after the fountain was last used

rejectedAnswers: after the fountain last was use

questions.explanation: after the fountain was last used保留最近使用在修复前二十年的先后，被动需used过去分词；was use不成被动结构。

questions.prompt:
The council considers durability more important than colour.
Use PRIORITY: The council ____ colour.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: gives higher priority to durability than
questions.explanation: give something priority over another或give higher priority to...than均保留耐久优先于颜色的方向；无higher时priority than缺少正确比较结构。

questions.prompt:
Without local donations, the work would have stopped.
Use BUT: The work would have stopped ____.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: but for表示若没有，保留当地捐款避免工程停下的过去反事实；but from不是这一条件表达。

questions.prompt:
The engineer warned us not to switch on the pump.
Use AGAINST: The engineer ____ on the pump.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: warn somebody against doing保留工程师警告我们不要开泵，属于警示而非新增命令；against后用switching不能用to switch。

materials.title: At a Ceramics Residency
materials.text:
1. First sentence: The ceramicist would prefer us to keep the door closed.
Second sentence: The ceramicist ____ the door closed.
Key word: RATHER

2. First sentence: The clay was not soft enough to shape by hand.
Second sentence: The clay ____ by hand.
Key word: TOO

3. First sentence: The kiln manager did not give us permission to add another piece.
Second sentence: We ____ another piece by the kiln manager.
Key word: PERMISSION

4. First sentence: She took great care while sanding the edge.
Second sentence: She ____ the edge.
Key word: CAREFUL

5. First sentence: The curators agreed to keep both earlier prototypes.
Second sentence: The curators ____ both earlier prototypes.
Key word: AGREEMENT

6. First sentence: I expected that completing the residency application would be difficult.
Second sentence: I ____ the residency application.
Key word: DIFFICULTY

questions.prompt:
The ceramicist would prefer us to keep the door closed.
Use RATHER: The ceramicist ____ the door closed.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: would rather somebody did表示希望别人当下保持门关，过去式为偏好虚拟而非过去事件；we keeping缺少有限谓语。

questions.prompt:
The clay was not soft enough to shape by hand.
Use TOO: The clay ____ by hand.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: not soft enough对应too hard，保持泥太硬不能手塑；too hard后接to shape，不用for shape。

questions.prompt:
The kiln manager did not give us permission to add another piece.
Use PERMISSION: We ____ another piece by the kiln manager.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: were not given permission to add
questions.explanation: 被动were not given permission to add保留经理未给我们加件许可，by仍指定同一施事；permission的动作补语不能直接用adding。

questions.prompt:
She took great care while sanding the edge.
Use CAREFUL: She ____ the edge.
Write only the missing words.
questions.explanation: take great care对应was very careful，when或while sanding保留打磨时的谨慎；省略从句中when sand不能构成合法动词结构。

questions.prompt:
The curators agreed to keep both earlier prototypes.
Use AGREEMENT: The curators ____ both earlier prototypes.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: came to an agreement to keep
questions.explanation: come to或reach an agreement to do保留策展人达成保留两个旧样的共识；keeping直接相接不能表达该约定的不定式内容。

questions.prompt:
I expected that completing the residency application would be difficult.
Use DIFFICULTY: I ____ the residency application.
Write only the missing words.
acceptedAnswers: expected to have difficulty in completing

rejectedAnswers: expected to have difficulty to completing

questions.explanation: expect to have difficulty doing或in doing保留对申请难填的过去预期，并不声称后来实际失败；to completing不能替代这一动名词结构。
